summary: Audit telemetry sampling policy, immutable handoff, and per-batch HMAC manifest for legal evidence
description:
Issue summary:
Customer requires a formalized delivery and verification model for audit telemetry to satisfy a regulatory evidence request. They want an immutable handoff using scheduled SFTP batches, each accompanied by a signed manifest (HMAC per batch) and a deterministic resume token so they can stitch events across days. Key asks: per-batch HMAC and manifest, deterministic event IDs, proof of monotonic ordering (including handling of late-arriving events), timezone canonicalization to UTC with signed checkpoints, and a short sample package that demonstrates preservation of per-event context (tenant IDs, request_id, model_version). Customer also requests KMS entropy proof showing that per-batch signing keys are rotated and attestable for the audit window.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - this is an onboarding / export specification request rather than a runtime bug. Customer provided examples of their ingest expectations and a small CDC feeder that produced out-of-order events when replayed into their SIEM; they need guidance to ensure Redwood's export ordering semantics satisfy legal-chain requirements.
logs: N/A - no error logs. Customer included a sample of 500 events (CSV) showing timestamp skew and duplicates; attached to their initial email and referenced in Slack thread #support-nordicbank-305.
comments: 2026-03-11 - Ava Thompson (Customer): We need an auditable, immutable delivery for audit events covering Feb 2026. Our legal team needs per-batch HMAC and a manifest with first/last timestamps, event count, and a resume token. Also require UTC canonicalization and a reproducible method to verify ordering after replay into our SIEM.

2026-03-11 - Diego Martinez (Support): Acknowledged. Assigning to export/infra eng for feasibility. Can you attach a sanitized sample and the exact manifest fields you expect? We'll confirm what Redwood can provide out of the box and where we need to add engineering support.

2026-03-12 - Customer: Attached sample CSV and desired manifest schema (sha256_hmac, first_timestamp, last_timestamp, batch_sequence, resume_token, record_count). Also included a short legal questionnaire excerpt asking for KMS rotation proof and HSM attestation.

2026-03-12 - Diego Martinez (Support): Noted. Eng please review: linked issue INT-3198 created for infra work to add HMAC manifest generator and signed checkpointing. Also opened PR draft for sftp-delivery manifest schema. See related_confluence page for proposed spec.

2026-03-13 - Eng (Nina Koh): Confirmed we support per-batch signing via service key, but customer requests KMS-backed HSM attestation and rotation history which requires coordination with Security and KMS team. We recommend an initial iterative deliverable: (1) signed manifest with HMAC (service key), (2) deterministic resume token (sha256 of first+last+batch_seq+tenant), (3) sample replay and verification script for customer. KMS/HSM attestation will be scoped separately.

2026-03-13 - Diego Martinez (Support): Shared proposed iterative deliverable and asked customer to confirm acceptance of a two-phase approach (Phase 1: immediate per-batch HMAC manifest + deterministic tokens; Phase 2: attested KMS-backed signing and rotation history). Requested business justification for Phase 2 (regulatory citation).
investigation_notes: Support triage 2026-03-11: Determine whether existing SFTP export supports manifest generation and resume tokens. Found export pipeline supports contiguous snapshots but not explicit per-batch HMAC manifests. Current checkpoints use signed JWT tokens for internal resume only.

Eng 2026-03-12: Reviewed export codepath. Two extension points: batch manifest generator (worker) and post-process hook to upload manifest to same SFTP folder. Deterministic resume token can be derived from event envelope fields; must agree canonicalization (UTC timestamps, canonical JSON field ordering).

Eng 2026-03-12: Late-arriving events - Redwood export is eventually consistent; ordering guarantees are per-ingest-shard sequence, not global. For legal evidence, propose including event_serial (per-producer monotonic counter) and server_receive_ts to help reconstruct ordering. Documented reconstruction algorithm in draft Confluence.

Security 2026-03-13: KMS attestation path requires exposing rotation logs and signed key metadata (key_id, rotation_time, signer_fingerprint). We can provide rotation audit from KMS but full HSM attestation will need SOC/security engagement and likely a formal ATO amendment for export scope.
Support 2026-03-13: Customer sample replay found 12 events with timestamp skew >5s; propose normalizing timestamps to canonical UTC and including original_timestamp field for forensic tracing.
resolution: Proposed phased deliverable: Phase 1 (ETA 2026-03-20): generate per-batch manifest (JSON) containing batch_sequence, first_timestamp_utc, last_timestamp_utc, record_count, sha256_hmac (using service signing key), deterministic resume_token. Provide a verification script and sample 1-day bundle for customer validation. Phase 2 (scoped, ETA TBD after security sign-off): KMS-backed signed manifests with rotation history report and HSM attestation artifacts. Customer to confirm Phase 1 acceptance to proceed.
